bluf: Mediaworks is a Newcastle based integrated brand, digital marketing and technology agency selling SEO, paid media, digital PR, creative and website builds to enterprise clients, with a roster heavy in UK water utilities, housing and public bodies. Its headline is a 300+ page customer first website for Southern Water. The record holds no dated moves, news or jobs, and the Horus read puts it Neutral at -2.6, most exposed to KJ4. A rival should know 22 of its 32 named clients are names only, it sells paid search and paid social while running 0 Google ads and no social pixel, and its blog has not updated in 12 months.
doing:
Mediaworks positions as an integrated brand, digital marketing and technology agency helping ambitious brands grow through combined creative, performance and technology strategies: in plain words, it builds websites and runs search, paid media and creative for utilities, councils, housing providers and universities. The headline claim is a customer first website of 300+ pages for Southern Water, built across multiple client teams. The record lists HQ Newcastle, offices in Leeds and Manchester, no founding year, employee count or owner; the one partner badge is Google's International Growth Partner Programme, gained early among UK agencies by its own account.

No line leads. Four score 2 as core: Paid Search (heads the Performance list; the page title claims PPC specialism), Paid Social (its LinkedIn ads share B2B paid social learnings from client campaigns), SEO (the Performance page title claims SEO specialism, a Tech SEO page, a LinkedIn ad for an Organic Search Director) and Web & Product (homepage builds for Southern Water, Citizen Housing, Currie & Brown and WYCA). Seven lines score 1 with no evidence note, AI search and data among them; AI automation, email and CRM, local and retail media score 0. The service menu adds Affiliate, Organic Social, Brand Foundations, Video & Motion Graphics and CX Design Consultancy; no proprietary product is listed.

Its AI posture is thought leadership without a service line: pieces on AI search visibility and AI shaped UX (an AI Zeitgeist, an AI web design masterclass, optimising a website for AI educated customers), yet AI search scores 1 and AI automation 0, though its site publishes an llms.txt. The record lists no dated moves or news; undated insight slugs record Platinum Umbraco Partner status and Michael Sherwood's appointment as Chief Customer Officer. No pricing signals, jobs or ATS appear. Conspicuously absent for a performance media seller: any Google ad of its own, any social pixel, measurement evidence, an owned audience line, and a dated case study.
clients:
Client type: enterprise; verticals: Utilities (water & energy), Housing associations, Higher education, Public sector, Financial services, Automotive and Retail & ecommerce; home market the UK.

The needs read holds 32 clients: 10 observed and 22 names only; the mix is brand (N3, 3), data (N5, 3), leads (N10, 2), organic (N1, 2) and web (N4, 1). No case carries a date, and five rows are title fragments or duplicates (A Transformative, West Yorkshire, Recruitment, a second Charles Tyrwhitt, a second WYCA). Southern Water came for the 300+ page web build. Charles Tyrwhitt came for organic demand: SEO for shirts, suits and trousers. York St John University came for data and content: a master's programme with video through Digital Knowledge Lab. WYCA came for Home Energy West Yorkshire, data driven energy insights for residents. Certas Energy (off grid energy) and Sealy (a UK digital revamp) are coded local and lead generation. Esh Group came for a three year transformation consolidating subsidiaries into one online identity; Tofoo for creative storytelling around meat free meals; Wisteria for brand presence.

Names only, need inferred from the mix: Metro Bank, Citizen Housing, Currie & Brown, Signifyd, Thor, Johnnie Johnson Housing, Gateshead Council, Yorkshire Water, Scottish Water, United Utilities, Northumbrian Water, Northern Powergrid, Michelin, Continental Tyres, Lookers Group, cinch, Newcastle University and Medical Protection Society; the Johnnie Johnson Housing, Gateshead Council and police recruitment cases carry uncoded excerpts. One client is shared, Yorkshire Water (jaywing).

What the base needs next, tied to KJ1 (citation replaces click) and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers): it is likely, moderate confidence, that utilities and public bodies ask for web builds and citation ready content before AI ads, and very unlikely that they buy audited AI visibility from an agency that publishes on it but does not sell it.
house: Say and do: 4 lines tested, 1 practised, integrity 25. LinkedIn advertising is corroborated: 6 company ads on the first results page, a floor because more pages exist, one hiring an Organic Search Director for its North East head office and one asking what is working in B2B paid social across client campaigns. Paid search is contradicted: it sells paid search and runs 0 Google ads in the Transparency Center. Paid social is contradicted: no social ad pixel on its own site. Publishing cadence is contradicted: a blog exists but nothing in its 603 sitemap URLs has updated in 12 months, 0 in 90 days and 0 in 365, and every insight slug the deepen pass found is undated. It does publish an llms.txt, blocks no AI crawler and carries 1 AI related URL. The tag stack is GTM and OneTrust on Next.js, Storyblok and Umbraco; no social pixel, test tool or ABM stack detected.
market:
The Horus read puts Mediaworks at a tailwind index of -2.6, band Neutral, percentile 16, 17:19 on the Solar Arc. Best placed for KJ1 (the click replaced by the citation) through AI Search / GEO and Paid Search, SEO pulling against, and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers) likewise. Most exposed to KJ4 (platforms absorbing the execution layer) through Paid Search and Paid Social, Data & Measurement offsetting, and KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out) through Paid Search, Paid Social and SEO. Best fit: The Toll Road at 37/100. Partial on P1 and P4 (no first party data, creative volume or measurement depth), absent on P2, P6, P7 and P8; P3 not applicable, P5 unknown.

The Monsoon read is 51.3, band Breeze, percentile 33: migration 53.8 against displacement 48.8. The mix supplies 54 of the index, SEO (12) and Web & Product (12) carrying most movable hours; work goes 65% to South and Southeast Asia, 20% to Eastern Europe and 15% to Africa and the Maghreb, automation overlapping 24%. Footprint inferred: no hub office, no onshore claim.
openings:
The strongest judgment is the three way house contradiction: Mediaworks sells paid search, paid social and content while running 0 Google ads of its own, no social pixel and a blog idle for 12 months, so a rival running its own programme on all three very likely (high confidence) wins the say and do comparison in any pitch that checks. Falsifier: Google ads, a Meta or LinkedIn pixel and sitemap updates in the last 90 days at the next compile close it.

The utilities roster is the contestable prize: Southern, Yorkshire, Scottish and Northumbrian Water and United Utilities, of which only Southern Water carries described work, and Yorkshire Water already sits on jaywing's book. The KJ4 exposure through Paid Search and Paid Social, with P4 partial, says the inputs platform automation consumes (first party data, creative volume, measurement depth) are absent from the record: that is the pitch. No feed, schema or entity work (P2 absent) leaves the machine readable layer unclaimed though it builds the websites. No public pricing model (P5 unknown) leaves an outcome priced offer unanswered. Displacement at 48.8 says price is roughly even (low confidence) as a lever; lead with web build proof and measurement.
watch: I7, holiday 2026 agentic checkout volume and merchant opt out rates, December 2026 to January 2027: disclosed AI checkout GMV would deepen the KJ4 exposure its paid lines carry, and high Shopify opt out rates would slow it.

I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, October 2026: output or outcome pricing at a top five holdco would press the KJ6 middle it sits in with no public pricing of its own.

I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, late October 2026: growth below 10% flags cannibalization, above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and the KJ1 tailwind it is best placed for.
I10, Reddit US daily users versus search referral volatility, late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.

The Organic Search Director hire advertised on LinkedIn: whether the next compile shows the post filled and an SEO or AI search case following tells whether the search line gets the evidence it lacks.
